title: Customers as Friendly Shareholders: Uncovering the Complex Mutual Fund-Broker Relationship
near_miss_reason: Table 10 Panel A (merger-shock ties) has a staggered binary absorbing treatment at the family-stock pair level (587 treated pairs in table10_portweights.dta, first post quarters 1998-2017, no switch-offs), but both columns replace pair FE with a single treatment_group dummy pooled across cohorts, with fund-quarter-style and stock-quarter FE. Timing varies within the treated group, so this is not Hull's unit/group FE form (same treatment as mnsc.2022.04062 'treat dummy instead of unit FE'). Not a controls-only near-miss; lead may override if a treated-group dummy is accepted as group FE.
eligible_reason: No reported column has unit (fund-stock pair) fixed effects. Table 10 Panel A: reghdfe hold_stock / weight_w on treatment_groupXpost and treatment_group, absorb(fund_qtr_style2 stock_qtr), three-way clustered. The fund x quarter and stock x quarter FE are admissible group-by-time FE (ruling Nov 1 ~21:40), but the unit-level FE is missing. Panels B-C add triple interactions and time-varying controls. Tables 2-9 use a non-absorbing brokerage-tie indicator or cross-sectional regressions without unit FE.
design_notes: Fund x stock x quarter holdings panel 1994-2017 (Thomson S12, N-SAR broker ties). Table 2: holdings/weights on family_broker_stock (time-varying tie dummy) with fund-qtr and stock-qtr FE. Table 3-4: ISS votes on ties x contentious with event and family-proposaltype-year FE. Tables 6-7: proposal/firm-level OLS with controls. Table 8: IPO allocations on ties with family-qtr and IPO FE. Table 10 (brokerage mergers as shock to ties): Panel A holdings (table10_holdings.dta, 94.4M rows, 182,702 treated-group rows) and portfolio weights (table10_portweights.dta, 12.3M rows; 33,669 treated-group rows, 587 family-stock pairs, 11 broker stocks, 271 families); Panel B voting DDD with inst_pct_holdings control; Panel C IPO allocation with controls.
estimators_reported: pooled DiD with treated-group dummy and group-by-time FE
n_adoption_cohorts_note: distinct first-post years among treated family-stock pairs in table10_portweights.dta (quarterly cohorts are more numerous); first post observed only when the pair is held
